column3: The Most Haunted Road in Britain
column5: In September 1987, two security guards driving along Stocksbridge Bypass in South Yorkshire encountered a group of young children dancing and singing by the roadside who vanished into thin air. Later, they saw a hooded figure dressed in monk-like garb that also disappeared.
The A666 in Bolton, known as 'The Devil’s Highway, ' is reputed to be haunted by shadowy figures and has a high accident rate

Conington Crossing in Cambridgeshire is believed to be haunted by the ghost of a colonel and his dog, who died in a train accident in the 1940s. The crossing has been the site of numerous accidents and paranormal activity.
A tramp named Elizabeth Campbell died on a road near Glespin in 1832, leading to local tales of her ghost haunting the area where she collapsed.

column3: Betty's Haunting on Betty Haunt Lane
column5: An innkeeper's daughter murdered by smugglers 200 years ago is said to manifest as a spectral figure walking along Betty Haunt Lane in Newport.

column3: The White Lady of Kirby Bedon
column5: A ghostly rider, the White Lady, is said to guard two churches in Kirby Bedon, Norfolk, riding a white horse along an ancient ley line.

The story tells of a terrifying encounter with a "sneering" ghost that stalks the coast road between Great Yarmouth and Lowestoft. Drivers have reported seeing this figure and even driving through it.

column3: The Ghosts of Dead Man's Lane
column5: Dead Man's Lane is a track between Old Mapperton and Netherbury that has been haunted by the spirits of plague victims buried there during the Black Death.

The story of the Waterston Lady tells of an old woman in a ragged dress who is seen walking along Waterston Road between Llanstadwell and Waterston, often holding a bundle of rags. She is said to emit an eerie blue glow.

column3: The Clogging Ghosts of Greenhow Hill
column5: The story revolves around the eerie phenomenon of ghostly clogs being heard on the roads around Stump Cross, near Greenhow Hill in North Yorkshire.

column3: The Phantom Executioner of Hangman's Hill
column5: A ghostly executioner is said to drag unsuspecting people up the hill using his spectral noose.

column3: The Grey Lady of the Dark Hedges
column5: A spectral figure known as the Grey Lady is said to glide along the shadowy path of the Dark Hedges, vanishing as the lane concludes.

A silent robed monk and a Roman soldier are reportedly seen walking along Spooky Lane near Devil's Bridge, Hertfordshire, with locals attributing the sightings to ancient Roman and medieval-era hauntings.

column3: The Phantom Monk of Barford Bridge
column5: The ghost of a monk is said to haunt a road near Barford Bridge, Northamptonshire, often appearing in the passenger seat of cars or stepping out onto the road, causing accidents and frightening drivers.
The ghost of a wealthy landowner is said to haunt his former room, throwing legal papers around in anger.

column3: The Phantom Eyes of Short Street
column5: Short Street in Longton, Stoke-on-Trent is known for its paranormal activity. People have reported feeling watched and experiencing strange phenomena such as the smell of cigarette smoke and voices.
A bus driver picks up a mysterious hitchhiker on a dark road between Dollar and Tillicoultry.
Two sisters driving on the A417 near West Hendred encounter a ghostly figure who vanishes before impact.
A 15ft tall stone known as the "Ghost Rock" or "Bogey Rock" is said to be haunted by a headless highwayman who was decapitated in a fight with a soldier.

column3: The Green Lady of Castle Mey
column5: The story tells of a young woman who fell in love with an unsuitable partner. Her father forbade the relationship and she was confined to the top floors of the castle, where she eventually died.

column3: The Ghostly Parade of Kinmount Straight
column5: Drivers on the A75 in Dumfriesshire have reported seeing ghostly figures, including groups of people pulling handcarts or carrying bundles.
A young couple driving through Longlevens, Gloucester, hit what they thought was a child but found no body or damage to their car.
The road near Bath, known as Sally in the Wood, is believed to be haunted by the ghost of a murdered girl named Sally. The area is notorious for eerie occurrences and an unsettling atmosphere.

The ghost story involves a pony that bolted with a coffin, leading to the disappearance of both the pony and the body. Months later, another pony pulling a different coffin also bolted at the same spot, resulting in the discovery of the first missing coffin but not the second.

column3: The Ghostly Hitchhiker of Burton Constable Hall
column5: A driver experiences a supernatural presence while driving to Burton Constable Hall, East Yorkshire's most haunted house.

column3: The Headless Woman of Buckland Bridge
column5: A farmer and his farmhand narrowly escape a violent encounter after encountering a headless woman on Buckland Bridge, who warns them of hidden robbers in the Glen.
Drivers on Platt Lane near Westhoughton report encountering ghostly miners hauling carts and glowing eyes in the hedges, linked to the 1910 Pretoria Pit disaster that claimed 344 lives.
The White Wife of Watlee is a legendary ghost figure on the island of Unst in Shetland, Scotland. She is said to appear to single men driving alone on a remote stretch of road near Loch Watlee.

column3: The Ghost of Blue Bell Hill
column5: The ghost of Judith Lingham, a young woman who died in a 1965 car crash on the A229, is said to appear as a hitchhiker or figure on the road before vanishing, with sightings reported for decades.
A highwayman's ghost haunts a stretch of road between Lancing and Steyning in East Sussex.

column3: The Ghostly Figure on the A470
column5: A driver and passenger reported seeing a ghostly figure with an oval, featureless head by the side of the road near Llyswen.

column3: The Ghostly Hitchhiker of Blue Bell Hill
column5: The story revolves around a phantom hitchhiker seen on the A229 near Maidstone, Kent. This ghost is often described as a young woman in white who appears to be hit by vehicles and then vanishes.
Jock's Road in Angus is periodically haunted by an anonymous figure dressed in winter clothes.

The story tells of a cyclist who encounters the ghosts of soldiers from the Battle of Killiecrankie, which took place in 1689. The cyclist witnesses a spectral battle and is terrified by the apparitions.
A man encountered a spectral knight in armor on Smithdown Lane during a dense fog in 1987, later realizing he had witnessed a timeslip to medieval times.

column3: The Green Lady of Vicar's Hill
column5: A young woman, Bellina Prior, is accused of killing a child and later returns as a ghost to haunt Vicar's Hill in Armagh.

column3: The Jaywalking Nun of Shady Lane
column5: A couple driving through Evington reported encountering a ghostly nun appearing directly in front of their car on Shady Lane, leaving skid marks but no collision.
Locals in Herefordshire attribute repeated accidents on the A465 near Bromyard to the ghost of a woman who died in a 1920s road collision after a struggle over her steering wheel.

column3: The Lady in Black on Edinburgh Road
column5: A paranormal investigator encounters a ghostly woman in black on Edinburgh Road near Cockenzie House.

column3: The Ghostly Tale of Calder House
column5: A young man named Liam Grant seeks refuge in a derelict house known as Calder House in Elgin, only to encounter a terrifying supernatural entity.
A mysterious white lady has been spotted on the Mullaghmoyle Road near Coalisland, County Tyrone, causing a stir and attracting crowds.
The story tells of ghostly hairy hands that appear on a stretch of road near Postbridge and Princetown on Dartmoor, Devon. These hands are said to grab at vehicles and try to force them off the road.
A phantom woman dressed in white is frequently seen on the main street of Llangennith, Gower.
The ghost of Madam Piggott is said to haunt a stretch of road near Chetwynd Park, Shropshire. She is often seen as a woman in white carrying a baby.

column3: The Ghostly Tale of Old Buckle
column5: This story recounts the legend of Old Buckle, a headless horseman who is said to haunt the road between Throckmorton and Bishampton in Worcestershire.

column3: The Ghostly Figure on Cadhole Road
column5: In 1972, a couple driving through Denbighshire encountered a ghostly figure on fire on Cadhole Road.

column3: The Ghosts of Maggie Murphy's Lane
column5: Maggie Murphy, her lover, and her enraged father are said to haunt Maggie Murphy's Lane following their tragic deaths in the 1880s. Witnesses report spectral figures and chilling phenomena along the road.
A truck driver encounters three ghostly men on the A40 road between Carmarthen and Llangathen, one of whom vanishes under his vehicle.

column3: The Phantom Headless Soldier of Barkham Road
column5: The ghost of a headless soldier is said to roam along Barkham Road in Berkshire, adding to the eerie atmosphere of the area.

The Ruskington Horror is a ghostly apparition that has been reported along the A15 road near Ruskington, Lincolnshire, for decades. The sightings include various spectral figures, such as a phantom cyclist and a little girl in a pink gown.
A vicar encounters a headless ghost on a moonlit road near Aldbourne, Wiltshire.

The Lady of the Lane is a ghostly apparition said to haunt the narrow roads between West Looe and Talland Bay in Cornwall. She appears as a woman dressed in white, with a sorrowful expression and no eyes.

column3: The Ghostly Hitchhiker of Hulbert Road
column5: A spectral hitchhiker is said to haunt a stretch of road in Waterlooville, Hampshire. Drivers have reported picking up a young woman who vanishes before reaching her destination.

column3: The Ghostly Encounter at Alloway Kirkyard
column5: Two American tourists fled after encountering a dark mist that created eerie sounds near the ruined kirk.

column3: The Victorian Ghost of Annan Road
column5: A spectral old lady in Victorian attire haunts a road near Annan, seen by multiple witnesses.

On December 11, 2002, multiple drivers reported witnessing a car crash on the A3 near Guildford. However, when police arrived, they found no evidence of a recent accident until they discovered an old wreckage and a body hidden in a ditch.

column3: The Phantom Passengers of the D-100 Highway
column5: Motorists traveling along the D-100 highway at night near the town of Kargali Hanbaba report seeing phantom passengers fleeing across the road who mysteriously vanish upon touching the pavement. This eerie urban legend stems from a tragic 1965 chemical accident on that exact stretch of roadway.

column3: The Ghost Boy of Dead Man's Curve
column5: Drivers who leave a coin on a specific bridge along Clinton Road at midnight may have it returned by the spirit of a young boy who drowned nearby. In more chilling accounts, the phantom attempts to push unsuspecting visitors into the water.

An eccentric woman who famously wandered the Newell Highway in New South Wales was tragically struck and killed by a truck in 1993. Since her death, motorists and truck drivers have frequently reported seeing her ghostly apparition pushing her shopping trolley along the highway after dark.

column3: The White Lady of Airport Road
column5: Drivers traveling past midnight frequently encounter a phantom woman in a white sari who suddenly materializes in the middle of the highway and rushes toward oncoming vehicles before vanishing.

The ghost of a medieval noblewoman appears along the mountain paths and border passes of Auvinyà to protect Andorra from foreign tyrants. She famously lured a despotic Bishop of Urgell into the woods, leading to his mysterious disappearance.
Travelers navigating the dark highway near the Chendebji Chorten on the Trongsa road frequently report eerie paranormal encounters tied to the legendary royal messenger who died there.

A medieval nun punished for a forbidden romance haunts a historic city street with phantom footsteps and shadowy apparitions. Witnesses along the thoroughfare report hearing her lingering steps and catching glimpses of her spirit near the former monastery site.

A ghostly twelve-year-old boy named Poloko perpetually waits by the A1 road traffic lights in Mmamashia for parents who never arrive. Unaware of his passing, his presence by the highway startles passing motorists before an elderly traveler stops to comfort him.
